extras: The plugin is privacy-first, ensuring audio never leaves the device and no network requests are made.
intentEvidence: This plugin layers convenience features on top: a pretty side-pane metadata view, 4-tier smart linking, a dashboard codeblock, and a version-mismatch banner.
problem: The standard Lugji integration provides raw Markdown notes, lacking integrated metadata visibility, smart knowledge graph connections, and easy-to-view meeting summaries within the vault.

relations.evidence: No dependency on the Dataview plugin.

summary: A plugin that enhances Lugji meeting notes by providing a metadata view, smart linking, and a meetings dashboard within Obsidian.
